comment: The class of each tool of kit (S1, K74): ecosystem names the tool it uses, replaced the library and its item, record the rebuild record, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies.

scripts/kit/check-dependency-policy-muta.reason: the mutation gate of polyspec's dependency policy: it proves that the policy check fails on each planted violation; no ecosystem tool checks a policy of ours

scripts/kit/check-dependency-policy.mts.reason: the gate of polyspec's dependency policy over the review records and the locks; it compares versions through version.mts, which K73 replaces

scripts/kit/check-documents.mts.reason: polyspec's document rules: translation pairs, revisions, relative links and anchors, site interpolation; its Markdown reading is markdown.mts

scripts/kit/check-editor-boundaries.mts.tool: amaro turns TypeScript into JavaScript, acorn and acorn-walk find the imports and eslint-scope the undeclared globals; the boundaries are polyspec's rules in config/editor-boundaries.json (K80)

scripts/kit/module-imports.mts.tool: amaro turns TypeScript into JavaScript, acorn parses it and acorn-walk finds the imports and the started modules, for the editor boundaries and the import graph of owner-check (K191)

scripts/kit/check-rules.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that every rule is enforced where it cannot be skipped: the check that each rule names and the reach of that check from CI and the hooks

scripts/kit/plan.mts.reason: the plan folders and checklist table of PRINCIPLES.md (K241, K242): writes a plan or a row only when it passes the checks of documents-check and the hooks

scripts/kit/verification.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that each item is verified by its own unit tests: the commands of the Verification cell of an open item, read with the refusals of the Claude Code hook (K249-3)

scripts/kit/duplication-check.mts.tool: jscpd finds the pieces of code that exist twice; the tool passes it the code formats of the runtimes and the excluded folders (K248-3)

scripts/kit/test-markers.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that no standard is lowered while testing: no runner of kit refuses its own skip and focus markers, so kit reads them in the tracked tests (K255)

scripts/kit/checklist.mts.reason: polyspec's checklists and trackers in Markdown tables; the table reading is markdown.mts

scripts/kit/ci-only.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that the full suite runs only in CI: the refusal of a suite command outside a GitHub Actions run

scripts/kit/ci-passed.mts.reason: the result of the last job of a polyspec CI workflow over the results of the other jobs

scripts/kit/ci-targets.mts.reason: runs make targets past failures and writes their report, polyspec's CI contract

scripts/kit/claude-hook.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that only the unit tests that own a change run locally, as the Claude Code PreToolUse hook of a repository

scripts/kit/composer-vendor.mts.tool: composer config vendor-dir, run with the Composer of the checkout in the folder of the composer.json, gives the vendor directory by Composer's own rule (K163, K184)

scripts/kit/dependency-review.mts.tool: npm, composer, go and cargo report the releases and advisories, and govulncheck its findings as SARIF (K124)

scripts/kit/dependency-state.mts.tool: smol-toml reads the pyproject manifests through toml.mts (K73); the locks are JSON or are read by their ecosystem tools

scripts/kit/documents-stamp.mts.reason: writes the revision marker of polyspec's translation pairs

scripts/kit/findings.mts.reason: the finding shape of kit's document checks

scripts/kit/generated-files.mts.reason: the generated-file rule of AGENTS.md: the segments it refuses and the exceptions that config/generated.json declares

scripts/kit/install-composer-project.mts.tool: composer install of the committed lock of a Composer project of kit (config/phpunit, config/php-lint), with the Composer of mise.toml (K77, K127)

scripts/kit/install-php-lint.mts.tool: composer install of the committed config/php-lint lock (K77)

scripts/kit/install-phpunit.mts.tool: composer install of the committed config/phpunit lock

scripts/kit/install-rust.mts.tool: rustup toolchain install of each Rust channel that config/toolchain.json exceptions declare

scripts/kit/install-symbols.mts.tool: go build of scripts/kit/symbols/go at its go.mod and go.sum, and composer install of the scripts/kit/symbols/php lock (K75)

scripts/kit/install-tools.mts.tool: mise install --locked of mise.toml and mise.lock (K127), then the installs of kit that mise does not cover: the wheel backend, the Composer projects and the symbol extractors

scripts/kit/install-vscode.mts.tool: @vscode/test-electron downloads the VS Code build of the extension tests (K80)

scripts/kit/kit-bootstrap.mk.reason: the bootstrap order of a repository before the package @polyspec/kit is installed (K71-2)

scripts/kit/kit-check.mts.reason: ties the copies of a repository to the version of @polyspec/kit that package-lock resolves (K71-2); npm checks the installed package, not the copies

scripts/kit/kit-sync.mts.reason: writes the copies that the package @polyspec/kit declares in kit.copies (K71-2); npm installs the package, and no npm tool writes files of a package into the repository

scripts/kit/kit.mk.reason: the make targets of polyspec that run the tools of kit

scripts/kit/lint-php.mts.tool: phpcs with phpcs.xml.dist, and PHPStan with phpstan.dist.neon (K77)

scripts/kit/link-build.mts.reason: the build state of a provider of the local links of 0.0.x development: the build targets it names and the digest of each npm package's inputs

scripts/kit/link-providers.mts.reason: the providers of the local links of 0.0.x development: the manifests of the main checkouts that name the packages they provide

scripts/kit/link.mts.reason: the local links of 0.0.x development, which point installed polyspec packages at their providers' sources through npm, Composer, uv, go and cargo, and no single ecosystem tool applies

scripts/kit/lint-steps.mts.reason: runs the steps of each lint tool of kit and reports each as polyspec's checks do (K77); every step is a linter of its ecosystem

scripts/kit/knip-ignore-hints.mts.tool: knip reporter API: the configuration hints of knip (K188)

scripts/kit/lint-ts.mts.tool: oxlint with oxlint-tsgolint, knip and API Extractor (K77)

scripts/kit/manifests.mts.tool: ajv validates the npm and Composer manifests and locks against the schemas of scripts/kit/schema through schema-validate.mts (K158)

scripts/kit/markdown.mts.tool: mdast-util-from-markdown with micromark-extension-gfm and the frontmatter extension reads the Markdown, github-slugger the GitHub anchors and @mdit-vue/shared slugify the VitePress anchors (K120)

scripts/kit/mise-tools.mts.tool: the shims of mise (var/tools/mise/shims), which run the releases of mise.lock (K127)

scripts/kit/owner-check.mts.reason: the owner rules of config/owner-checks.json are polyspec's; the targets, prerequisites and recipes come from GNU make's database, make -pRrq (K121), and the imports of the import graph from module-imports.mts (K191)

scripts/kit/parity-declaration.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity-errors.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity-ledger.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity-runners.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity-symbols.mts.tool: the standard library's ast of Python, API Extractor, golang.org/x/tools/go/packages, nikic/php-parser and rustdoc JSON read the public symbols (K75)

scripts/kit/parity-text.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity-units.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/parity.mts.reason: the language-parity check of polyspec, classified with K75

scripts/kit/pin-python-dependency.mts.tool: @decimalturn/toml-patch rewrites the pin and keeps the text (K122)

scripts/kit/present.mts.reason: polyspec's rule that code reads a value it knows to be there with what it expects, instead of asserting it away with ! or a type assertion (K156, K157)

scripts/kit/push-gate.mts.reason: the push gate over polyspec's checklist trackers

scripts/kit/pylock.mts.tool: smol-toml reads the PEP 751 locks through toml.mts (K73)

scripts/kit/pyproject-dependencies.mts.reason: lists the dependency arrays of a pyproject.toml for dependency-state and pin-python-dependency, and resolves the include-group tables of [dependency-groups] as the reference implementation of PEP 735 does; no npm package reads dependency groups (K177)

scripts/kit/python-lock.mts.tool: pip-requirements-js reads the PEP 508 requirements (K73); the pin policy on top is kit's rule

scripts/kit/rebuild-check.mts.reason: checks the classes of config/rebuild.json, polyspec's S1 declaration

scripts/kit/recipe-tools.mts.reason: polyspec's rule that a make recipe starts a tool of the checkout by its absolute path (K171); the recipes come from GNU make's database through owner-check.mts, split into words by the quoting rules of the POSIX shell with the parse of shell-quote (K179, K184)

scripts/kit/release-assets.mts.reason: polyspec's pins of the release archives of its own repositories, which no registry serves, by version and sha256 under var/; the download is the fetch of Node.js and the extraction unzip

scripts/kit/release-backend.mts.tool: pip download of the declared wheels

scripts/kit/release-consumer-config.mts.reason: release-please, changesets and semantic-release version and publish, but none proves a consumer install of every archive; their tag ordering goes to semver in K73

scripts/kit/release-consumer.mts.reason: release-please, changesets and semantic-release version and publish, but none proves a consumer install of every archive; their tag ordering goes to semver in K73

scripts/kit/release-proof.mts.reason: release-please, changesets and semantic-release version and publish, but none proves a consumer install of every archive; their tag ordering goes to semver in K73

scripts/kit/release-tools.mts.tool: install-tools (mise install --locked) and rustup for the release toolchains

scripts/kit/release-wheel.mts.tool: pip install --dry-run --report reads the METADATA of a wheel (K123) and smol-toml the pyproject (K73)

scripts/kit/release.mts.reason: release-please, changesets and semantic-release version and publish, but none proves a consumer install of every archive; their tag ordering goes to semver in K73

scripts/kit/run-tests.mts.tool: node --test, vitest, go test, cargo test, PHPUnit and unittest

scripts/kit/schema-validate.mts.tool: ajv (Ajv2020) validates the configs against the schemas (K73)

scripts/kit/status-table.mts.reason: polyspec's status tables; the table reading is markdown.mts

scripts/kit/target-report.mts.reason: the report of a run of make targets, polyspec's CI contract

scripts/kit/test-selection.mts.reason: the rule of PRINCIPLES.md that a local test run selects its tests: which arguments of each test runner select a file, a name or an id

scripts/kit/test-progress.mts.reason: the progress lines that every runner prints, polyspec's output contract

scripts/kit/toml.mts.tool: smol-toml reads every TOML file of kit, the one TOML reader (K73)

scripts/kit/toolchain-exceptions.mts.reason: the declared exceptions to the pins, each with its scope, reason and retry condition (S4, S8, K78)

scripts/kit/toolchain-files.mts.tool: go mod edit -json reads go.mod, cargo metadata the Cargo manifests, npm config get the .npmrc keys, and smol-toml through toml.mts the TOML manifests (K78)

scripts/kit/toolchain-floors.mts.reason: the floors of the manifests must equal the pins (S4, K78); the manifests are read by their ecosystem tools through toolchain-files.mts

scripts/kit/toolchain-lint.mts.reason: reads the declarations of the lint tools in config/toolchain.json and config/php-lint/composer.lock after the bootstrap (K77); the install of each tool has its own class here

scripts/kit/toolchain-lock.mts.tool: mise lock for linux-x64 and macos-arm64, and mise install --locked of uv and python for the uv lock of a pypi: tool (K127)

scripts/kit/toolchain-mise.mts.reason: polyspec's rule that mise.lock pins every tool of mise.toml by the sha256 of its archive of each platform, a go: tool excepted for the checksum database of Go; mise.toml and mise.lock are read by smol-toml (K127)

scripts/kit/toolchain-pins.mts.reason: the toolchain pins of polyspec that kit ships (S4, K78)

scripts/kit/version.mts.tool: semver for npm and Go and @renovatebot/pep440 for PyPI compare the versions (K73); kit compares no Composer versions

scripts/kit/wheel-dependencies.mts.tool: pip install --dry-run --report reads the Requires-Dist of a wheel (K123) and pip-requirements-js their PEP 508 form (K73)
